cases.name: producer_corruption
cases.scenario: A detects a value already invalid at its input
cases.required_behavior: retain the upstream producer; do not assign cause solely to A

cases.name: consumer_checker_error
cases.scenario: A rejects a valid synthetic value while independent oracle accepts it
cases.required_behavior: retain and test A and the checker; do not automatically blame producer

cases.name: stale_plan
cases.scenario: B returns epoch 7 for a request bound to epoch 8 after declared invalidation
cases.required_behavior: retain B and A until independent module tests discriminate

cases.name: valid_old_snapshot
cases.scenario: request is correctly bound to old epoch 7 with valid lifetime
cases.required_behavior: do not classify epoch 7 as stale solely because current catalog is 8

cases.name: missing_invalidation
cases.required_behavior: include the owner of the missing obligation although no event exists

cases.name: async_context_loss
cases.scenario: sender exists but receiver link is absent
cases.required_behavior: mark incomplete and retain delivery path; absence is not proof of nonexecution

cases.name: object_id_reuse
cases.scenario: same object ID reappears with different generation
cases.required_behavior: separate identities and detect stale references

cases.name: multiple_writers
cases.scenario: two allowed writers can affect a state version
cases.required_behavior: retain both histories and ordering until discriminated

cases.name: trace_loss
cases.scenario: required event is lost to sampling or ring buffer wrap

cases.name: revision_mismatch
cases.scenario: symbol map and build digest disagree
cases.required_behavior: mark bundle INVALID and do not assert source localization

cases.name: storage_dependency
cases.scenario: recovery symptom depends on an unverified persistence receipt
cases.required_behavior: retain storage adapter and durability sequence, not only recovery function

cases.name: two_causes
cases.scenario: two independent defects jointly violate an invariant
cases.required_behavior: retain both causes; do not force a single culprit

cases.name: unsafe_boundary
cases.scenario: unresolved memory corruption can cross FFI boundary
cases.required_behavior: expand candidate scope; a missing normal call edge cannot exclude influence

cases.name: insufficient_predicate
cases.scenario: byte checksum passes but semantic invariant fails
cases.required_behavior: do not exclude upstream based on checksum alone

cases.name: schema_upgrade
cases.scenario: new same-major tool opens old minor diagnostic bundle
cases.required_behavior: decode or convert preserving identity, unknowns and witness meanings

cases.name: instrumentation_budget
cases.scenario: repeat equivalent workload with instrumentation enabled and disabled
cases.required_behavior: measure throughput, tail, memory, trace loss and schedule sensitivity under declared budget
